title: Oracle and Db2 change events carry names in upper case
symptom: Events for ORACLE1.TPCH1.ORDERS matched no lower-case table in the schema
cause: Both keep unquoted identifiers in upper case, and Debezium reports them as stored
effect: Silver built from a lower-case model finds no events
fix: Fold the schema's names per source (upper for Oracle and Db2, lower for Informix)
